title: 1.0.15: real domain and credential registry, audit evidence, readable at any size
body: Every permissioned domain and credential on mainnet, read by a sweep of the ledger; admission checks with SHA-256 records; audit trails screened against OFAC and the scam registry with a signed manifest. Text is larger, scaling fills the window, and 2FA sign-in is fixed.

title: 1.0.14: safer to hold XRP, easier to trust who holds it
body: An emergency kit for drained accounts, a reviewed scam registry and phishing check, withdrawal screening, and Customer Asset Protection: proof from the XRP Ledger that customer XRP is backed and yours is counted. Verification, not insurance.

title: Every download is now labelled BETA
body: The desktop builds are pre-1.0 and unsigned while the release pipeline is hardened. The download section now says so on every artifact rather than only in the operator note underneath, so the channel is never read as stable by accident.

title: Public site rebuilt around live feeds
body: The site now carries a live XRP newsroom, this mission log, a support console and a contact channel. Every page is rendered on the server before it is served, so the content is in the HTML a crawler receives rather than assembled afterwards in the browser.

title: Accounts and the hosted workspace were withdrawn from the site
body: Sign-in and the hosted dashboard are gone. NOSHASHI runs on your machine and reads public ledger state; the website no longer asks anyone to create an account to evaluate it. Existing links redirect rather than breaking.
